title: tc-agent-steering
description: Steer an agent while it works: the run, its plan, the queued notes and a field to add one.

heading.description: What the agent is working on, e.g. "Migrate users table"

agent.description: Name of the agent or model, e.g. "Opus 5.5"

steps.description: The plan: done steps, the active one and the steps still to come, in order

queue.description: Notes waiting for the next step, oldest first

status.description: Where the run is: "running", "paused" or "done" – done disables the field

startedAt.description: When the run started (epoch ms or a Date) – the clock in the header ticks from here

placeholder.description: Placeholder of the field while the run is open

pausable.description: Shows Pause in the header while running (tc-pause)

resumable.description: Shows Resume in the header while paused (tc-resume)

duration.description: Time the step took in ms – shown on done steps

startedAt.description: When the active step started – its clock ticks from here

notes.description: Notes the agent took in for this step – a note that leaves the queue and shows up here glides over

picked.description: Set when the agent took the note in – shows "Picked up" (or "Interrupted" when it was applied right away)
